```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(colf)
library(ggthemes)
library(Metrics)
source(here("helper/run_k_fold.R"))

adult_bd <- read_csv(here("adults/adult_exposure_duration.csv"))
infant_bd <- read_csv(here("infants/data/infant_exposure_duration.csv"))%>% filter(fam_or_test == 'test', !exclude)

adult_resnet50_eig <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_eig.csv"))
infant_resnet50_eig <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_infant_exposure_duration/01_linked_sim/linked_resnet50_eig.csv"))
```

```{r}
renaming <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
  group_by(param_id, trial_type) %>%
  filter(all(2:10 %in% trial_number)) %>% # only keep parameters for which all fam durations have been computed
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(test_type = trial_type) %>%
  mutate(fam_duration = trial_number - 1,
         test_type = case_when(test_type == 'background' ~ 'fam', test_type == 'deviant' ~ 'nov')) 
  return(df)
}

infant_resnet50_eig <- infant_resnet50_eig %>% filter(!(trial_number == 1 & trial_type == 'deviant')) %>% renaming()
```


```{r}
p_id = 1


run_joint_fit <- function(adult_d, infant_d, adult_sim, infant_sim, p_id){
  


adult_data_to_fit <- summarize_behavioral_data(adult_bd) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    left_join(adult_resnet50_eig %>% filter(param_id == p_id) %>% ungroup(), by = c("trial_number", "trial_type")) 

infant_data_to_fit <- summarize_behavioral_data_infants(infant_bd) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  left_join(infant_resnet50_eig %>% filter(param_id == p_id) %>% ungroup(), by = c("fam_duration", "test_type")) 

joint_scale_dataset <- adult_data_to_fit %>% 
  mutate(type = "adults") %>% 
  #select(type, mean_lt, mean_sample) %>% 
  mutate(mean_lt = mean_lt / 1000) %>% 
  bind_rows(
    infant_data_to_fit %>% 
      mutate(type = "infants")  
      #select(type, mean_lt, mean_sample)
  ) 

fitted_stats = colf_nlxb(mean_lt ~ mean_sample, data = joint_scale_dataset, lower = c(-Inf, 0.0000001))
sample_slope = fitted_stats$coefficients["param_mean_sample"]
sample_intercept = fitted_stats$coefficients["param_X.Intercept."]
    
scaled_data <- joint_scale_dataset %>% 
  mutate(scaled_samples = mean_sample * sample_slope  + sample_intercept)

#calculate the r

adult_scaled <- scaled_data %>% filter(type == "adults")
adult_rsquared <- cor(adult_scaled$mean_lt, adult_scaled$scaled_samples)^2
adult_rmse <- rmse(adult_scaled$mean_lt, adult_scaled$scaled_samples)

infant_scaled <- scaled_data %>% filter(type == "infants")
infant_rsquared <- cor(infant_scaled$mean_lt, infant_scaled$scaled_samples)^2
infant_rmse <- rmse(infant_scaled$mean_lt, infant_scaled$scaled_samples)

res = tibble(
      "param_id" = p_id, 
      "adult_rsquared" = adult_rsquared,
      "adult_rmse" = adult_rmse,
      "infant_rsquared" = infant_rsquared, 
      "infant_rmse" = infant_rmse

    )

return(res)
}


  
run_joint_fit(adult_d = adult_bd, infant_d = infant_bd, adult_sim = adult_resnet50_eig, infant_sim = infant_resnet50_eig, p_id = 2)
```


```{r}
full_joint_search <- lapply(
    unique(adult_resnet50_eig$param_id), 
    function(id){
      run_joint_fit(adult_d = adult_bd, 
                    infant_d = infant_bd, 
                    adult_sim = adult_resnet50_eig, 
                    infant_sim = infant_resnet50_eig, p_id = id)
    }
  ) %>% 
    bind_rows()
```

```{r}
full_joint_search %>% arrange(-adult_rsquared) #159  
full_joint_search %>% arrange(-infant_rsquared) #31

full_joint_search %>% arrange(-adult_rmse) #5
full_joint_search %>% arrange(-infant_rmse) #23

```

```{r}
param_info <- read_csv(here("simulations/sim_adult_exposure_duration/param_info/param_info_resnet50_eig.csv"))
param_info %>% select(param_id, V_prior, alpha_prior, beta_prior, sd_epsilon, world_EIGs) %>% 
  filter(param_id == 159 | param_id == 31) %>% 
  mutate(param_id = if_else(param_id == 159, "adults", "infants"))

param_info %>% select(param_id, V_prior, alpha_prior, beta_prior, sd_epsilon, world_EIGs) %>% 
  filter(param_id == 5 | param_id == 23) %>% 
  mutate(param_id = if_else(param_id == 159, "adults", "infants"))
```
